question: v1
asks: What total amount in USD of NVIDIA’s credit-support commitments and minimum-revenue guarantees or backstops to AI labs and cloud partners, including the support for the additional lab’s nearly 2 gigawatts of computing capacity, will be disclosed in NVIDIA’s FY2027 Form 10-K and related quantified disclosures by the annual report’s publication?
settles_on: The disclosed amount of guarantees, credit-support commitments and revenue backstops NVIDIA has extended to AI labs and cloud partners (including the credit support for nearly 2 gigawatts of computing capacity for one additional AI lab), versus the equity investments it has made, at NVIDIA's next annual report.

possible_answers.label: Neutral
possible_answers.holds_when: from 25,000,000,000 USD to below 50,000,000,000 USD (no reference figure when the question opened)
